conditions: After lawful activation for work-result variants; at activation for known mismatches.

grounding.quote:
3. authorised action selection: it assigns priority, determines the effect

conditions: Where the executive configuration is selected and the actor occupies Executive.

grounding.quote:
An actor occupying the Executive frame modifies no candidate, Product or
worktree bytes and performs no implementation effect. Filesystem or tool
access is no exception, and neither is an edit that is small, test-only,
reversible or apparently obvious. Mutation requires a separately activated
Worker or Writer relation carrying the exact operation grant, subject and
write territory. A same-actor role transition is explicit and is recorded in
the existing work carrier before the effect; for that effect the actor is no
longer acting as Executive. Recording or delegating after an Executive edit
cannot authorise the edit retroactively

constraints.statement: No candidate, Product or worktree byte modification or implementation effect is permitted while Executive. Access, size, test-only scope, reversibility, obviousness and even a construction/status/checkpoint operation grant create no exception. Mutation requires a separately activated Worker/Writer relation with exact operation grant, subject and write territory. A same-actor transition must be explicit and recorded in the existing carrier before the effect, which is then not an Executive effect. Later recording or delegation cannot retroactively authorise an edit.

conditions: While the known material unclosed evaluation frontier is non-empty.

grounding.quote:

  apply only declared conjunctions or translations
  assign priority and boundary effect only under the current Product mandate
  invalidate affected results when the subject or basis changes
  update U from coverage, dependencies, conflicts and discovered materiality

stop only when every mandatory evaluation is closed, or governing authority
has explicitly retained every remaining residual consistently with the claim

constraints.statement: Select finite dependency-ready M fitting actors; activate each on exact outcome/basis; keep assurance-independent evaluations free of unclosed peer results; wait for decision-relevant input when no other authorised decision is ready. Record every closed result, triage, residual and invalidator; use only declared conjunctions/translations; assign priority/boundary effect under current mandate; invalidate affected results on subject/basis change; update U from coverage, dependencies, conflicts and discovered materiality. Stop only after every mandatory evaluation closes or governing authority explicitly retains every remaining residual consistently with the claim. Parallel activation is possible. Recursion follows declared dependencies and bounded refinements, never undifferentiated frame copies; no scheduler/engine is required. Severity, priority, boundary effect, disposition and next action remain separate ledger entries. Results return through declared relations with closed result/source routes, not hidden reasoning, and never self-activate continuation.

exceptions: Unavailable or unreliable notification, or an actual supervision obligation, calls for bounded fallback observation.

grounding.quote:
Executive attention is event-driven by default. The Executive re-enters the
attention cycle for a decision-relevant closed result, a material exception
or changed basis, an owner request, or a declared deadline or checkpoint.
While Workers carry out their bounded grants and no other authorised
decision is ready, it waits. It does not repeatedly inspect unfinished work,
replay unchanged judgments or request status without a decision need

constraints.statement: Default re-entry triggers are decision-relevant closed results, material exceptions/basis changes, owner requests and declared deadlines/checkpoints. While Workers execute and no authorised decision is ready, wait rather than repeatedly inspect unfinished work, replay unchanged judgments or request unnecessary status. Keep frontier, return conditions and valid support; refresh affected support on material observation and revalidate locks before activation/disposition. Waiting waives no workspace verification, evidence validity, independent assessment, closed-result consumption, authority or closure duty. Fallback observation declares purpose, cadence/checkpoint, evidence target and stop/escalation. Silence proves neither progress nor failure; unknown status is not a stalled Worker. Investigate genuine blockers/material risk and intervene where required within grants. Repeated no-progress or no-new-evidence returns require bounded reassessment of frame, grant, dependency or evidence gap and an existing-authority decision, not continued polling/repeated repair on unchanged basis. Reduced churn lowers neither assurance nor capability and creates no universal cost, budget or accounting gate.

conditions: Executive configuration selected.

grounding.quote:
Where it is selected, every grant, duty, limit and prohibition this

Selecting the configuration makes none of them optional, and no operation
grant lifts them

conditions: Delivery under this profile's selected strategy.
